hypotheses.note: vol g != 0 and some bvol g j != 0 (S > 0), as in lem_capstar

hypotheses.paper: the step u -> |u| (l.458-460): |grad|u|| = |grad u| a.e., tr|u| = |tr u|
hypotheses.note: AbsLatticeApprox in thm_main: for every u, w_k in D with w_k >= 0, dirichlet w_k <= dirichlet u, trace L^{p#} norms <= those of u, and ||w_k||^2_{p*} -> ||u||^2_{p*}. The exact AbsLattice (|u| in D with no larger energy, as on W^{1,2}) gives it (AbsLattice.approx). The C^1 reading of OQ-93 (b) gives it through w_e = sqrt(u^2+e^2) - e (argued, not formalized), though |u| itself is not C^1. thm_main_signed does not use it

hypotheses.paper: eq:star for u >= 0 with a finite constant A (l.183-189)

hypotheses.paper: A >= 0 (follows from eq:star by Hoelder, V^{2/p*} u-bar^2 <= ||u||^2_{p*})
hypotheses.note: the Lean holds for every real A; a harmless generalization

hypotheses.paper: lambda_partial = inf over u != 0 of F_g (l.132)

findings: l.458-460 and l.519: the reduction to u >= 0 serves eq:star alone. eq:linear holds for every u with |u-bar| in place of u-bar, by lem:capacitary and lem:holder applied to u and to -u (Yamabe.MeasuredModel.eq_linear). So the squaring at l.519 needs no sign. Under eq:star for every u, eq:main follows with no lattice property (Yamabe.MeasuredModel.eq_main_signed, thm_main_signed). This confirms the planner's [r] claim.

l.204 (and the abstract, l.82; l.901): the O(F_g(1)^2) is uniform in theta. With R the exact remainder (Yamabe.mainRem), |R| <= (20/7) theta/(1+theta)^2 (A F/a_N)^2 when |A F/a_N| <= (1+theta)/(4 theta) (mainRem_le). Also |R| <= (5/7)(A F/a_N)^2 when |A F/a_N| <= 1/4, for every theta > 0 (mainRem_le_uniform). So the term is O(delta^2) with delta = A F_g(1)/a_N, and its constant depends only on (A/a_N)^2. Fixing theta is not needed.

eq:main and eq:main-asymp are otherwise correct as printed. Lambda_max is the larger eigenvalue of the calibrated matrix (lamMax_largest_eigenvalue). Lambda_max(M) = Lambda_max^norm/F_g(1) (l.546-550, lamMax_unnormalized). The derivative of 1/Lambda_max in delta at 0 is -alpha/(1+alpha)^3, i.e. the relative loss eps/(1+theta)^2 of l.559 (hasDerivAt_inv_lamMax).
questions: (a) The step u -> |u| (l.458-460) is not carried by the model of record (DEC-186). It needs only an approximate lattice property, carried here as AbsLatticeApprox. That property follows from the exact one on W^{1,2} (AbsLattice.approx), and under the C^1 reading of OQ-93 (b) from w_e = sqrt(u^2+e^2) - e (argued). So thm_main with prop:starN (eq:star for u >= 0) gives thm:main for every N >= 3 under either reading. The round-1 claim of a gap for N >= 4 under the C^1 reading was wrong; the audit (AUDIT-1) corrected it. The only open point is which form of the lattice hypothesis is of record: exact AbsLattice or AbsLatticeApprox. thm_main takes the weaker one. Separately, thm_main_signed avoids the lattice step altogether at the price of eq:star for every u.

(b) O(F_g(1)^2) (l.204) is a statement about one (Sigma, g), so an existential remainder would be vacuous. Reading taken: the remainder is the fixed function Yamabe.mainRem N theta A of F, depending on the model only through (theta, A, F_g(1)). eq:main-asymp is then eq:main rewritten exactly (eq_main_asymp_identity). The remainder is O(F^2) as F -> 0 at fixed theta, A (mainRem_isBigO), with the explicit bounds mainRem_le and mainRem_le_uniform. Accept?

OQ-109: thm_main_three is thm:main at the single constant star3AtilCorr, the corrected constant proved valid by star3_of_consts for any Poincare constant lambda > 0 and Sobolev-Poincare constant C. It never uses the printed A-tilde. Its truth does not depend on the OQ-109 ruling, but its statement is pinned to star3AtilCorr. Another ruling would be instantiated through thm_main_signed or thm_main at the constant of record.

kb_proposals: pattern: an O(.) term in a statement about one object (eq:main-asymp) must be a fixed function of the parameters, since an existential remainder is vacuous. Define the exact remainder (Yamabe.mainRem), prove the statement as an identity, then prove IsBigO and an explicit bound separately.

pattern: the larger eigenvalue of [[p, q], [q, r]] with q >= 0. Work with the explicit root Lambda = (p+r+s)/2: (Lambda-p)(Lambda-r) = q^2, and the form bound follows from (sqrt(Lambda-p) x - sqrt(Lambda-r) y)^2 >= 0. det(M - mu 1) is Matrix.det_fin_two and then simp with Matrix.cons_val_zero/one (Yamabe.quad_le_lamMax, lamMax_largest_eigenvalue).

pattern: an explicit O(delta^2) for 1/Lambda(delta) without calculus. Lambda solves Lambda^2 - T Lambda + delta = 0, so h = 1/Lambda solves P(h) = delta h^2 - T h + 1 = 0, and (h - g)(Lambda - delta g) = P(g) for any g. Take g the linearisation and bound Lambda - delta g below. HasDerivAt then follows from hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO and IsBigO.trans_isLittleO (isLittleO_pow_id one_lt_two) (Yamabe.inv_lamMax_sub_le, hasDerivAt_inv_lamMax).

pitfall: an eventual bound near a limit is Filter.Tendsto.eventually_le_const (hv : v < u) (h : Tendsto f l (nhds v)) : eventually f <= u. It is a to_dual name, absent from grep for 'theorem ...eventually_le_const'; use it with filter_upwards.

pattern: on the model, the step u -> |u| of perforated l.458-460 is the Prop MeasuredModel.AbsLatticeApprox (scaffold Perforated/Main): nonnegative w_k with no larger energy and trace norms and ||w_k||_{p*} -> ||u||_{p*}. le_Fq_of_lattice passes to the limit with ge_of_tendsto. The exact AbsLattice implies it (constant sequence), and the C^1 reading satisfies it through w_e = sqrt(u^2+e^2) - e although |u| is not C^1. The toy model satisfies the exact form (toy_absLattice).

pattern: eq:capineq needs only 0 < cap*: sqrt_capStar_mul_ell_le applied to u and -u gives |ell(u)| <= X/sqrt(cap*) for finite-energy u, with cap* = oo handled by ell_eq_zero_of_capStar_eq_top (Yamabe.MeasuredModel.eq_linear_of_capStar_pos).
notes: Round 2 (fix of AUDIT-1, verdict major on the claims, not the Lean). No statement removed. (1) AbsLattice is weakened to AbsLatticeApprox in thm_main, eq_main_lattice, eq_main_lattice_of_capStar_pos and le_Fq_of_lattice. Each hypothesis is weaker, so each theorem is stronger. AbsLattice.approx gives it from the exact form; toy_thm_main uses it. The false claim that the C^1 reading lacks thm:main for N >= 4 is withdrawn from SCOPE, question (a) and the kb proposal. (2) The l.543 finding is dropped: eq:star forces A >= 0 by Hoelder. A remark stays in SCOPE: the Lean needs no sign of A, since only sqrt(alpha' beta') >= 0 matters. The checklist row is fixed. (3) The module docstring is shortened. 'Provenance:' is at character 5915, and the ledger regex SCOPE_BLOCK finds the whole SCOPE within text[:8000]. (4) thm_main_three is described as thm:main at the single constant star3AtilCorr, a special case. (5) SCOPE: eq:main takes only 0 < cap* from lem:capstar; eq:main-asymp also takes cap* < oo. Still one file, sorry-free, builds as YamabeScaffold.Perforated.Main, axioms propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound. No name clashes with the strict library or Upper.lean (checked by grep). Anchor candidates: Yamabe.MeasuredModel.thm_main (printed form) and thm_main_signed. The witnesses toy_thm_main_hyps and toy_capStar_route_hyps show the hypotheses jointly satisfiable on the two-point toy model.
